1	"""Roofline analysis for every race pipeline (optimizer × model) on H100.
2	
3	Owner directive: the optimization target is distance-to-roofline (not watts),
4	tracked at 10-step granularity.
5	
6	Methodology (ncu SpeedOfLight is unavailable in this container —
7	ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM/RmProfilingAdminOnly=1 — so this uses first-principles
8	measurement, stated explicitly):
9	  • achieved FLOP/s  = FLOPs_per_step / wall_per_step
10	      - wall_per_step: the REAL race train function run with evaluation
11	        disabled (pure train steps), CUDA-synchronized wall over 100 steps
12	        after 25 warmup steps. A second pass with eval_every=10 records the
13	        per-10-step time series via the race's _eval_callback hook (labelled
14	        "incl. eval overhead" — the race's own tracking cadence).
15	      - FLOPs_per_step: torch.profiler(with_flops=True) over 20 steps of the
16	        same pipeline (GEMM/conv-registered FLOPs; elementwise ops register 0,
17	        so this slightly UNDERcounts — conservative for "how close to roof").
18	  • arithmetic intensity AI = FLOPs_per_step / bytes_per_step, with an
19	    analytical traffic model (documented in bytes_per_step below): weights are
20	    read for fwd+bwd, grads written+read, optimizer state read+written
21	    (per-optimizer state-tensor counts), activations written in fwd and read
22	    in bwd.
23	  • roofline ceiling at AI = min(PEAK_COMPUTE, AI × HBM_BW); closeness =
24	    achieved / ceiling. PEAK_COMPUTE is chosen by what eager fp32 matmul can
25	    legally hit on this torch build (TF32 tensor cores if
26	    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 else FP32 CUDA cores); both ceilings
27	    are drawn on the plot regardless.
28	
29	Outputs: results/h100_grokking_race/roofline.json, roofline.png, ROOFLINE.md.
30	Run:  python -m tuning.roofline [--models decoder,vit,mamba] [--steps 100]
31	"""
32	from __future__ import annotations
33	
34	import argparse
35	import json
36	import sys
37	import time
38	from pathlib import Path
39	
40	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
41	OUT = ROOT / "results" / "h100_grokking_race"
42	
43	# H100 SXM5 datasheet ceilings (dense, no sparsity)
44	PEAKS = {
45	    "fp32_cuda": 66.9e12,    # FP32 CUDA cores
46	    "tf32_tc": 494.7e12,     # TF32 tensor cores
47	    "bf16_tc": 989.4e12,     # BF16/FP16 tensor cores
48	    # [A6-HIGH] FP8/INT8 tensor-core dense rate. H100 datasheet quotes 3958
49	    # TFLOP/s FP8 *with sparsity*; dense = 3958/2 = 1979 ≈ 1978.9e12. INT8 TOPS
50	    # matches the FP8 rate on H100, so both share this ceiling.
51	    "fp8_tc": 1978.9e12,     # FP8 (e4m3/e5m2) tensor cores, dense
52	    "int8_tc": 1978.9e12,    # INT8 tensor cores, dense (= FP8 rate)
53	    "hbm_bw": 3.35e12,       # HBM3 bytes/s
54	}
55	
56	# [A6-HIGH] precision label -> compute ceiling. fp16amp rides the BF16/FP16 TC
57	# carrier (same peak as bf16); fp8/fp8e5m2/int8 use the low-precision TC rate.
58	_PRECISION_PEAK = {
59	    "bf16": PEAKS["bf16_tc"], "fp16amp": PEAKS["bf16_tc"],
60	    "tf32": PEAKS["tf32_tc"], "fp32": PEAKS["fp32_cuda"],
61	    "fp8": PEAKS["fp8_tc"], "fp8e5m2": PEAKS["fp8_tc"], "int8": PEAKS["int8_tc"],
62	}
63	
64	# [R2.4 item 2] BATCH-SATURATION SWEEP (decoder, min-of-3 wall, quiet GPU). The
65	# operating-point evidence: the one-CTA-per-SM TC megakernel is occupancy-pinned, so
66	# its throughput (samples/s = achieved FLOP/s, FLOPs linear in B) saturates at B≈2k
67	# (one 16-row dW atom × 132 SMs ≈ 2112) and DECLINES past 16k — batch does NOT buy
68	# roofline fraction for it. Eager (cuBLAS batched GEMMs) saturates much later (≈32-65k)
69	# because it is not occupancy-capped. B=16384 is the chosen shared point (owner's
70	# "B≈16k+" floor; megakernel within 3.5% of its peak there; eager at its knee). This
71	# is the honest negative result (no-suppression): the path to higher megakernel

73	# run JSON as `batch_saturation_sweep`.

175	def _tile_train_data(data, B):
176	    """DETERMINISTIC repeat-tile the TRAIN split (tx, ty) of a race data tuple up
177	    to exactly B rows (owner directive R2.4 item 2: "tile data if dataset<max;
178	    full-batch repeated/tiled deterministically"). The race train functions consume
179	    the WHOLE (tx, ty) every step (full-batch grokking), so a larger tx/ty IS a
180	    larger train batch — this is the only surface needed to drive the megakernel /
181	    eager paths at B without touching the train loop.
182	
183	    Tiling is index-only (``idx = arange(B) % n_train``) — NO RNG, NO new samples:
184	    sample i appears ⌈B/n⌉ times, byte-identical across runs, so the wall, FLOPs/step
185	    and peak VRAM are reproducible. If B <= n_train we truncate (never upsample past
186	    the requested B). The eval/val/test splits (vax..tey) pass through UNCHANGED —
187	    the roofline disables eval (eval_every=1e9) so they are never touched; keeping
188	    them intact preserves the train-fn signature.
189	
190	    data = (tx, ty, vax, vay, tex, tey). Returns the same tuple with tx, ty tiled.
191	    """
192	    import torch
193	    tx, ty = data[0], data[1]
194	    n = tx.shape[0]
195	    if B is None or B == n:
196	        return data
197	    idx = torch.arange(B, device=tx.device) % n     # deterministic, RNG-free
198	    return (tx[idx], ty[idx]) + tuple(data[2:])

201	def bytes_per_step(opt, model, n_params, batch, seq, dim, layers):
202	    """Analytical main-memory traffic per training step (bytes, fp32).
203	
204	    weights: fwd read + bwd read           = 2 · 4N
205	    grads:   bwd write + optimizer read    = 2 · 4N
206	    params @ optimizer: read + write       = 2 · 4N
207	    state:   read + write per state tensor = 2 · 4N · S_opt
208	    activations: fwd write + bwd read      = 2 · 4 · A
209	      A ≈ batch · seq · dim · layers · k, k≈14 for attention blocks
210	      (qkv/attn-matrix/proj/mlp saves), k≈10 for mamba blocks.
211	    """
212	    k = 10 if model == "mamba" else 14
213	    acts = batch * seq * dim * layers * k
214	    s = STATE_TENSORS[opt]
215	    return 4.0 * (2 * n_params + 2 * n_params + 2 * n_params
216	                  + 2 * n_params * s + 2 * acts)

237	def _resolve_precision(opt, model, tuned_configs):
238	    """[A6-HIGH] (matmul_precision_str, use_amp, precision_label) for (opt, model).
239	
240	    If the tuner picked a winner for this cell, use ITS precision/AMP; else fall
241	    back to grokking_race_v2._resolve_matmul_precision on the default config (the
242	    per-model auto policy). The label is what gets drawn on the plot and chosen
243	    from _PRECISION_PEAK: fp16amp (use_amp=True) rides the bf16 carrier."""
244	    g = _g()
245	    params = (tuned_configs.get(opt) or {}).get("params") if tuned_configs else None

248	            return "fp32", True, "fp16amp"      # fp16 autocast; carrier peak = bf16
249	        mp = params.get("matmul_precision")

251	            return mp, False, mp

253	    dc = dict(g.DEFAULT_CONFIG); dc["model_type"] = model
254	    mp = g._resolve_matmul_precision(dc)
255	    return mp, False, mp

258	def measure_pipeline(opt, model, timed_steps, tuned_configs=None,
259	                     force_precision=None, max_batch=None):
260	    import torch
261	    g = _g()
262	    data, init, n_params = _data_init(model)
263	    # [R2.4-MAXBATCH item 2] train every cell at the per-model max batch (same B
264	    # within a model, deterministic repeat-tile of the native train split). B is
265	    # chosen at the SM-saturation operating point (16384 by default — one 128-row
266	    # tile per 132 SMs; the megakernel's one-CTA-per-SM throughput is already within
267	    # ~3.5% of its 4k-batch peak there, and eager is at its utilization knee). The
268	    # wall, FLOPs/step and peak VRAM below are then all measured AT this batch.
269	    if max_batch is not None:
270	        data = _tile_train_data(data, max_batch)
271	    dev = torch.device("cuda")
272	    # [A6-HIGH] per-pipeline precision: prefer the tuner's winning precision for
273	    # this (opt, model); fall back to the auto-resolved default. Applied to EVERY
274	    # run config below so wall/AI measure the tuned precision, and the ceiling
275	    # uses that precision's peak.
276	    if tuned_configs is None:
277	        tuned_configs = _load_tuned_configs(model)
278	    mp_str, use_amp, prec_label = _resolve_precision(opt, model, tuned_configs)
279	    # [ROOFLINE-FP32] OWNER OVERRIDE: when force_precision is set (e.g. "fp32"),
280	    # pin EVERY run config to it, overriding the tuner/auto resolution. This is the
281	    # whole point of the re-measure: the decoder auto-default is bf16, which makes
282	    # _try_fused_train_step DECLINE the L3 persistent megakernel (precision gate in
283	    # grokking_race_v2: L3 fires only when resolved precision == fp32). Forcing fp32
284	    # makes decoder/vit/mamba × adamw run the TRUE L3 real fwd+bwd+opt megakernel
285	    # (validated: the run banner prints "L3-REAL fused-train path ENABLED" and the
286	    # fused_train_counter advances every step). The other 8 optimizers run
287	    # eager-fp32 + the L1 fused optimizer tail (L1 has no precision gate). Every row
288	    # is then read against the fp32 CUDA-core ceiling (66.9 TF) — the uniform basis
289	    # the old bf16 chart lacked.
290	    if force_precision is not None:
291	        mp_str, use_amp, prec_label = force_precision, False, force_precision
292	
293	    # [ROOFLINE-PATH] Verify which path ACTUALLY executes (owner: "label paths
294	    # explicitly"; don't infer from gate logic). We wrap the dispatch entry points
295	    # to count real L3 / L1 firings for THIS pipeline, and read the process-global
296	    # _FUSED_ABI_STALE flag — if it tripped, L3 silently degraded to eager and the
297	    # "L3 measurement" would secretly be eager-fp32 (wrong thing measured).
298	    _counters = {"l3": 0, "l1": 0}
299	    # [ROOFLINE-ENGINE] capture the ACTUAL GEMM engine the L3 path ran (task 2):
300	    # decoder/vit bf16 → "wgmma" (TC), mamba bf16 + any fp32 → "scalar". The engine
301	    # — NOT the requested precision — drives the row's path label, precision label,
302	    # AND compute ceiling (a scalar engine computes fp32 → 66.9 TF peak even when
303	    # the config precision string is "bf16"; without this, a scalar-executing cell's
304	    # achieved-fp32 ÷ bf16-ceiling craters its fraction ~15× silently).
305	    _last_engine = {"engine": None}
306	    _orig_l3 = g._try_fused_train_step
307	    _orig_l1 = g._try_fused_step
308	    def _wrap_l3(*a, **k):
309	        r = _orig_l3(*a, **k)
310	        if r is not None:
311	            _counters["l3"] += 1
312	            if g.LAST_L3_ENGINE is not None:
313	                _last_engine["engine"] = g.LAST_L3_ENGINE["engine"]
314	        return r
315	    def _wrap_l1(*a, **k):
316	        r = _orig_l1(*a, **k)
317	        if r:
318	            _counters["l1"] += 1
319	        return r
320	
321	    def _cfgp(steps, ee):
322	        c = _cfg(opt, model, steps, ee)
323	        c["matmul_precision"] = mp_str; c["use_amp"] = use_amp
324	        return c
325	    fn = getattr(g, {
326	        "adamw": "train_adamw", "neuralgrok": "train_neuralgrok",
327	        "grokadamw": "train_grokadamw", "supergrok": "train_supergrok",
328	        "supergrok15": "train_supergrok15", "supergrok2": "train_supergrok2",
329	        "grokfast": "train_grokfast", "muon": "train_muon", "lion": "train_lion",
330	        "looksam": "train_looksam", "prodigy": "train_prodigy"}[opt])
331	
332	    # ── pass 1: pure-train wall (eval disabled). One DISCARD run first absorbs
333	    # process-global one-time costs (cuBLAS/cuDNN handles, kernel ABI caches),
334	    # then two lengths are timed and differenced — per-run setup (model build +
335	    # state-dict load) cancels in the diff, leaving pure marginal step cost.
336	    # [ROOFLINE-PATH] the path counters wrap the dispatch entries for the WHOLE
337	    # wall pass so we record what actually ran (L3 / L1 / eager), not what the gate
338	    # would permit. use_fused stays True + the forced precision is in effect, so the
339	    # REAL megakernel is what is timed.
340	    g._try_fused_train_step = _wrap_l3
341	    g._try_fused_step = _wrap_l1
342	    # [R2.4-PEAKVRAM item 2] capture PEAK VRAM of the PRODUCTION path only. This MUST
343	    # be measured during the wall pass (use_fused=True → the real megakernel/L1 path),
344	    # NOT across the whole function: pass 3 (FLOP count) runs use_fused=False → EAGER
345	    # for every cell, and eager allocates the full activation graph while the
346	    # megakernel keeps activations CTA-local. A whole-function max_memory_allocated
347	    # would report the eager-flop-pass VRAM for the 3 adamw megakernel cells —
348	    # misrepresenting exactly the production paths this table exists to characterise.
349	    # Reset before the warmup so the reading is steady-state (warmup transients
350	    # included is fine — they ARE part of the path's footprint), capture right after

355	        c = _cfgp(25, 10**9)
356	        torch.manual_seed(42)

358	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
359	        walls = []
360	        for steps in (15, 15 + timed_steps):
361	            c = _cfgp(steps, 10**9)

363	            t0 = time.perf_counter()

365	            torch.cuda.synchronize()
366	            walls.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)

370	        g._try_fused_step = _orig_l1

372	    # Steps that fired L3/L1 across the two timed runs (15 + (15+timed)).
373	    _wall_total_steps = 15 + (15 + timed_steps)
374	    l3_fired = _counters["l3"]; l1_fired = _counters["l1"]
375	    l3_engine = _last_engine["engine"]   # "wgmma" | "scalar" | None (task 2)

377	        actual_path = "eager+L1(ABI-stale)" if l1_fired else "eager(ABI-stale)"

380	        # owner directive's path labels): L3-TC bf16 vs L3-scalar fp32.
381	        if l3_engine == "wgmma":
382	            actual_path = "L3-TC-megakernel(wgmma)"
383	        elif l3_engine == "scalar":
384	            actual_path = "L3-scalar-megakernel"
385	        else:
386	            actual_path = "L3-real-megakernel"  # engine unknown (should not happen)
387	    elif l1_fired > 0:

393	    # mp_str — wgmma computes bf16 (989 TF peak), scalar computes fp32 (66.9 TF). For
394	    # eager/L1 rows keep the requested-precision label/peak (those DO run at mp_str).
395	    eng_prec_label = prec_label

398	    elif l3_engine == "scalar":

403	    series = []
404	    last = [None]
405	    def cb(step, ta, va, tea):

428	    # GEMMs/convs; a fused custom megakernel is ONE opaque kernel that registers
429	    # ZERO FLOPs. With use_fused=True on the L3 cells (decoder/vit/mamba × adamw
430	    # under forced fp32) the profiler would see ~0 FLOPs/step and crater achieved
431	    # FLOP/s for exactly the cells we are trying to measure. EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED:
432	    # decoder×adamw fp32 profiled 2.23e9 FLOPs/step with use_fused=True vs
433	    # 4.23e10 with use_fused=False (~19×). FLOPs/step is dtype- AND path-
434	    # independent (the math is identical), so the eager count is the CORRECT
435	    # FLOPs/step for the L3 megakernel; achieved = (eager-counted FLOPs)/(L3 wall)

528	def _build_tc_module(model, verbose=False):
529	    """JIT-build the model's TC TU (mirrors the test _build_tc_module: 9.0a,
530	    -O3 -std=c++17 --expt-relaxed-constexpr, sm_90a gencode). Cached per model.
531	    Raises on build failure (the caller skips TC rows per the owner's "skip if
532	    JIT-path still blocked")."""
533	    import os
534	    if model in _TC_MOD_CACHE:
535	        return _TC_MOD_CACHE[model]
536	    os.environ["TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST"] = "9.0a"
537	    from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load
538	    tu = str(ROOT / _TC_TU_REL[model])
539	    mod = load(
540	        name=f"mega_{model}_real_adamw_tc",
541	        sources=[tu], extra_include_paths=[str(ROOT)],
542	        extra_cuda_cflags=[
543	            "-O3", "-std=c++17", "--expt-relaxed-constexpr",
544	            "-gencode=arch=compute_90a,code=sm_90a",
545	            "-gencode=arch=compute_90a,code=compute_90a", "-lineinfo"],
546	        extra_cflags=["-O3", "-std=c++17"], verbose=verbose)
547	    _TC_MOD_CACHE[model] = mod
548	    return mod

551	def _tc_inputs(model, B, dev):
552	    """Per-model (params, input, targets) for one TC/scalar step at batch B. The
553	    flat params are random of the TC TU's TOTAL size — step TIME is independent of
554	    param VALUES (correctness is already validated by the cells' gates: decoder
555	    13/13+5, vit 21/21, mamba 5/5), so we don't need the exact named layout here.
556	    decoder/mamba take int32 tokens [B,seq]; vit takes float32 patches [B,16,49]."""
557	    import torch
558	    mod = _build_tc_module(model)
559	    total = int(mod.TOTAL)
560	    gpar = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(42)
561	    params = (torch.randn(total, generator=gpar, device=dev) * 0.02).contiguous()
562	    gin = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(7)
563	    if model == "vit":
564	        from tests.hw.vit_oracle import NUM_PATCHES, PATCH_DIM, VOCAB
565	        inp = torch.randn(B, NUM_PATCHES, PATCH_DIM, generator=gin, device=dev).to(torch.float32)
566	        tgt = torch.randint(0, VOCAB, (B,), generator=gin, device=dev).to(torch.int32)
567	    elif model == "mamba":
568	        from tests.hw.mamba_oracle import VOCAB, P_HEAD, SEQ
569	        inp = torch.randint(0, VOCAB, (B, SEQ), generator=gin, device=dev).to(torch.int32)
570	        tgt = torch.randint(0, P_HEAD, (B,), generator=gin, device=dev).to(torch.int32)
571	    else:  # decoder
572	        from tests.hw.decoder_oracle import VOCAB, SEQ
573	        inp = torch.randint(0, VOCAB, (B, SEQ), generator=gin, device=dev).to(torch.int32)
574	        tgt = torch.randint(0, VOCAB, (B,), generator=gin, device=dev).to(torch.int32)
575	    return mod, params, inp, tgt, total

578	def _time_tc_kernel(call, warmup=8, iters=40):
579	    import torch
580	    for _ in range(warmup):
581	        call()
582	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
583	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
584	    for _ in range(iters):
585	        call()
586	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
587	    return (time.perf_counter() - t0) / iters

590	def measure_tc_cell(model, eager_flops_full, eager_B_full, n_params,
591	                    seq, dim, layers):
592	    """Measure the directly-loaded TC TU for `model` (Task 2) AND its scalar
593	    sibling (Task 3) at the same B%16 full batch, ncta_cap=0 (full saturation).
594	
595	    eager_flops_full / eager_B_full: FLOPs/step and batch from the eager adamw
596	    profile (pass 3 of measure_pipeline, use_fused=False — the path-independent
597	    GEMM count). FLOPs scale linearly in B, so flops_at(B) = eager_flops_full ·
598	    B / eager_B_full. Returns a list of two rows (tc, scalar) or [] if the JIT
599	    build is blocked.
600	    """
601	    import torch
602	    dev = torch.device("cuda")
603	    B = eager_B_full - (eager_B_full % 16)          # decoder TC requires B%16==0
604	    try:
605	        mod, params, inp, tgt, total = _tc_inputs(model, B, dev)
606	    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 — JIT blocked → owner says skip TC rows
607	        print(f"  TC[{model}] BUILD/SETUP FAILED (skipping TC rows): {e}", flush=True)
608	        return []
609	    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
610	    torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
611	    flops_per_step = eager_flops_full * (B / float(eager_B_full))
612	    beta1, beta2 = 0.9, 0.98
613	    bc1, bc2 = 1.0 - beta1, 1.0 - beta2
614	    lr, eps, wd = 1e-3, 1e-8, 0.0
615	    state = torch.zeros(3 * total, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
616	
617	    def _tc_call():
618	        return mod.tc_train_step(params.clone(), inp, tgt, state, lr, beta1, beta2,
619	                                 eps, wd, bc1, bc2, 1, 0)
620	    def _sc_call():
621	        return mod.scalar_train_step(params.clone(), inp, tgt, state, lr, beta1,
622	                                     beta2, eps, wd, bc1, bc2, 1)
623	
624	    rows = []
625	    for label, family, prec, call, has in (
626	        ("tc_train_step",     "tc",     "bf16-TC", _tc_call, True),
627	        ("scalar_train_step", "scalar-mega", "fp32", _sc_call,
628	         hasattr(mod, "scalar_train_step")),
629	    ):
630	        if not has:
631	            continue
632	        try:
633	            wall = _time_tc_kernel(call)
634	        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
635	            print(f"  TC[{model}] {label} FAILED: {e}", flush=True)
636	            continue
637	        # Bytes/AI: keep the SAME analytical traffic model as the scalar rows for
638	        # cross-row comparability (adamw S=2), BUT the TC kernel stores activations
639	        # in bf16 (2B not 4B). The activation term dominates at these B, so an
640	        # all-fp32 byte model understates TC AI ~2×. We report BOTH: the fp32-model
641	        # AI (comparable to every other row) and a TC-faithful AI (activations 2B).
642	        # CAVEAT (load-bearing): the TC point lands MEMORY-bound in this analytical
643	        # model (AI·BW < bf16 peak), so the ceiling — and thus the fraction —
644	        # depends on this byte assumption. The achieved TF/s (the honest axis) does
645	        # NOT. The writeup leads with achieved TF/s and reports BOTH AIs for TC.
646	        bps_fp32 = bytes_per_step("adamw", model, n_params, B, seq, dim, layers)
647	        # TC-faithful: halve the activation byte term (acts stored bf16).
648	        acts = B * seq * dim * layers * (10 if model == "mamba" else 14)
649	        bps_tc = bps_fp32 - 2 * 4.0 * acts + 2 * 2.0 * acts  # acts 4B→2B
650	        bps = bps_tc if family == "tc" else bps_fp32
651	        achieved = flops_per_step / wall
652	        ai = flops_per_step / bps
653	        ai_fp32model = flops_per_step / bps_fp32
654	        peak_c = PEAKS["bf16_tc"] if family == "tc" else PEAKS["fp32_cuda"]
655	        ceiling = min(peak_c, ai * PEAKS["hbm_bw"])
656	        bound = "compute" if peak_c < ai * PEAKS["hbm_bw"] else "memory"
657	        rows.append({
658	            "optimizer": "adamw", "model": model,
659	            "precision": prec, "use_amp": False,
660	            "path": f"L3-real-megakernel({label})", "path_family": family,
661	            "tc_batch": B, "ncta_cap": 0,
662	            "steps_per_s": 1.0 / wall, "wall_per_step_ms": wall * 1e3,
663	            "flops_per_step": flops_per_step,
664	            "flops_basis": "eager-profiled (use_fused=False) scaled by B/B_full",
665	            "bytes_per_step_analytical": bps,
666	            "bytes_model": ("tc-faithful (acts bf16 2B)" if family == "tc"
667	                            else "fp32 (all 4B)"),
668	            "achieved_flops_per_s": achieved,
669	            "arithmetic_intensity": ai,
670	            "arithmetic_intensity_fp32model": ai_fp32model,
671	            "matmul_peak_used": peak_c,
672	            "roofline_ceiling_flops_per_s": ceiling,
673	            "fraction_of_roofline": achieved / ceiling,
674	            "bound_regime_at_AI": bound,
675	            "achieved_bytes_per_s_analytical": bps / wall,
676	            "fraction_of_hbm_bw": (bps / wall) / PEAKS["hbm_bw"],
677	            "per10step_series_incl_eval": [],
678	        })
679	    if len(rows) >= 2:
680	        tc_r = next((r for r in rows if r["path_family"] == "tc"), None)
681	        sc_r = next((r for r in rows if r["path_family"] == "scalar-mega"), None)
682	        if tc_r and sc_r:
683	            ratio = sc_r["wall_per_step_ms"] / tc_r["wall_per_step_ms"]
684	            print(f"  TC[{model}] B={B} ncta=0  TC={tc_r['wall_per_step_ms']:.3f}ms "
685	                  f"scalar={sc_r['wall_per_step_ms']:.3f}ms  speedup(scalar/TC)="
686	                  f"{ratio:.2f}×  ({'TC wins' if ratio > 1 else 'scalar wins'})",
687	                  flush=True)
688	    return rows

781	def _delta_vs_baseline(rows, baseline_path):
782	    """[ROOFLINE-DELTA] Diff the new scalar rows against the archived eager
783	    baseline (same (optimizer, model) key, path_family scalar). Reports the change
784	    in roofline-fraction / achieved-TF/s / precision/path so the owner can see what
785	    moved when the L3 megakernel actually fired."""
786	    try:
787	        base = json.loads(Path(baseline_path).read_text())
788	    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
789	        return []
790	    bmap = {(r["optimizer"], r["model"]): r
791	            for r in base.get("rows", []) if r.get("path_family", "scalar") == "scalar"}
792	    out = []
793	    for r in rows:
794	        if r.get("path_family", "scalar") != "scalar":
795	            continue                       # deltas only defined for the scalar race rows
796	        b = bmap.get((r["optimizer"], r["model"]))
797	        if not b:
798	            continue
799	        # [ROOFLINE-DELTA] Decompose WHY the fraction moved (advisor): a fraction
800	        # jump can come from (a) a real PATH change (adamw: eager+L1 → L3 real
801	        # megakernel) or (b) a pure CEILING relabel (the other opts only changed
802	        # precision bf16→fp32, dropping the ceiling 285→66.9 TF, so the same
803	        # achieved TF/s reads as a higher fraction — NOT more efficient). We record
804	        # the OLD path + a path_changed flag + the ceiling ratio so the writeup
805	        # never implies fp32 made 10 optimizers faster (it did not).
806	        # The eager baseline predates path labelling AND the extension build fix
807	        # (per the commit timeline the fused path was broken then → every baseline
808	        # row ran eager / eager+L1). So "did the PATH genuinely change" = did the
809	        # NEW row fire the L3-real megakernel (the only path this fp32-force newly
810	        # enables). The non-adamw rows ran eager+L1 in BOTH (ceiling-relabel only).
811	        path_old = b.get("path") or "eager (unlabelled pre-fix)"
812	        # A real L3 megakernel fired iff the path starts "L3-" (now "L3-TC-..."/
813	        # "L3-scalar-..." after the bf16/wgmma wiring; was "L3-real-..." pre-wiring).
814	        path_changed = str(r.get("path", "")).startswith("L3-")
815	        ceil_old = b.get("roofline_ceiling_flops_per_s", 0.0) or 0.0
816	        ceil_new = r.get("roofline_ceiling_flops_per_s", 0.0) or 0.0
817	        tf_old = b.get("achieved_flops_per_s", 0) / 1e12
818	        tf_new = r.get("achieved_flops_per_s", 0) / 1e12
819	        out.append({
820	            "optimizer": r["optimizer"], "model": r["model"],
821	            "precision_old": b.get("precision"), "precision_new": r.get("precision"),
822	            "path_old": path_old, "path_new": r.get("path"),
823	            "path_changed": path_changed,
824	            "roof_frac_old": b.get("fraction_of_roofline"),
825	            "roof_frac_new": r.get("fraction_of_roofline"),
826	            "roof_frac_delta": (r.get("fraction_of_roofline", 0)
827	                                - b.get("fraction_of_roofline", 0)),
828	            "achieved_tf_old": tf_old, "achieved_tf_new": tf_new,
829	            "achieved_tf_ratio_new_over_old": (tf_new / tf_old) if tf_old else None,
830	            "ceiling_tf_old": ceil_old / 1e12, "ceiling_tf_new": ceil_new / 1e12,
831	            "ceiling_ratio_old_over_new": (ceil_old / ceil_new) if ceil_new else None,
832	            "steps_per_s_old": b.get("steps_per_s"),
833	            "steps_per_s_new": r.get("steps_per_s"),
834	            # the honest tag: did the underlying WORK change, or just the ceiling label?
835	            "interpretation": ("PATH CHANGED (real megakernel now measured)"
836	                               if path_changed else
837	                               "ceiling-relabel only (precision changed, work same)"),
838	        })
839	    return out

2	
3	The persistent megakernel's compute roofline (task #13) is diagnosed/optimized at a
4	LARGE model width. This is the FIRST-CLASS coexisting bench-variant build: it
5	JIT-compiles the SAME decoder TC cell TU (csrc/fused/sm_90/mega_decoder_real_adamw_tc.cu)
6	as a SEPARATELY-NAMED extension (default name "mega_decoder_real_adamw_tc_bench"), with
7	its OWN torch-extensions build dir + ninja incremental rebuild + sccache, so each
8	hill-climb iteration rebuilds incrementally and NEVER touches the production _ops.so
9	or the 33/33 gate.
10	
11	  * -DSG_DEC_BENCH_LAYOUT=1  -> the d=1024 layout branch of decoder_layout.cuh
12	                               (the proven end-to-end width; A/A/A, parity 2.4e-07).
13	  * -DSG_DEC_PROFILE=1       -> the in-kernel clock64 per-phase timers (default OFF;
14	                               NEVER on the production path).
15	
16	USAGE
17	  # Deliverable B: per-phase wall breakdown of one d=1024 adamw/decoder step.
18	  python tuning/decoder_bench.py --profile --d 1024 --B 16384 --reps 3
19	  python tuning/decoder_bench.py --profile --d 1024 --B 2048  --reps 3   # small-B
20	  # Throughput-only (TF/s, steps/s) without instrumentation perturbation:
21	  python tuning/decoder_bench.py --d 1024 --B 16384 --reps 3
22	  # Sanity at production width (must match the 33/33 cell):
23	  python tuning/decoder_bench.py --profile --d 128 --B 16384
24	
25	Notes:
26	  * d is selected at COMPILE time (the layout is a compile-time constant); --d 1024
27	    sets -DSG_DEC_BENCH_LAYOUT=1, --d 128 leaves it unset (production branch).
28	  * Inputs are RANDOM (throughput/phase split, not a parity gate — correctness was
29	    proven separately). params/state are sized from the TU's exposed mod.TOTAL.
30	  * The clock64 stamps measure the SLOWEST CTA per phase (atomicMax), which is the
31	    critical path the host wall sees (the trailing grid barrier waits for it).

54	    """JIT-build the decoder TC cell TU as a coexisting variant extension. Distinct
55	    module name + own build dir => incremental ninja rebuild, sccache-friendly, and

59	    knob sweep: -DSG_TUNED_DEC_DW_SPLITK=8). Each distinct define-set gets its own
60	    module name (suffix from the KEY=VAL pairs) so variants coexist + cache cleanly.
61

119	def _decoder_gemm_flops_per_step(d: int, B: int, layers: int, seq: int, vocab: int) -> float:
120	    """Analytic GEMM FLOPs for one fwd+bwd decoder step (the dense matmul work the
121	    roofline counts; LN/softmax/elementwise register ~0 in the profiler convention).
122	    T = B*seq rows. Per layer the GEMMs are: QKV proj (d->3d), attn-out (d->d),
123	    ff0 (d->dff=4d), ff2 (dff->d). Plus the output head (d->vocab). Each GEMM is
124	    2*M*N*K MACs*2. Backward ≈ 2x forward (dX + dW), so fwd+bwd ≈ 3x forward."""
125	    T = B * seq
126	    def gemm(M, N, K):
127	        return 2.0 * M * N * K
128	    dff = 4 * d
129	    fwd = 0.0
130	    for _ in range(layers):
131	        fwd += gemm(T, 3 * d, d)      # in_proj
132	        fwd += gemm(T, d, d)          # out_proj
133	        fwd += gemm(T, dff, d)        # ff.0
134	        fwd += gemm(T, d, dff)        # ff.2
135	    fwd += gemm(B, vocab, d)          # output head (last position only: M=B)
136	    # attention score/context GEMMs (small: seq=4) — include for completeness.
137	    for _ in range(layers):
138	        fwd += gemm(T, seq, d // 1)   # QK^T-ish (seq small; negligible)
139	    return 3.0 * fwd                  # fwd + bwd(dX+dW) ≈ 3x

281	def main():

2	
3	Mirrors tuning/decoder_bench.py. JIT-compiles the SAME ViT TC cell TU
4	(csrc/fused/sm_90/mega_vit_real_adamw_tc.cu) as a SEPARATELY-NAMED coexisting
5	extension (own torch-extensions build dir + ninja incremental + sccache), so a
6	before/after knob sweep (-D SG_TUNED_VIT_GEMM_INTERLEAVE=1 vs default 2) — or the
7	d-scaled size-ladder build — rebuilds incrementally and NEVER touches the
8	production _ops.so or the 33/33 gate.

10	  * --d 1024  -> -DSG_VIT_BENCH_LAYOUT=1 (the d=1024 branch of vit_layout.cuh, the
11	                 size-ladder roofline width, HEADS=16 via the d/64 head-dim rule) +
12	                 -DSG_VIT_SCALAR_MEGAKERNEL=0 (the scalar megakernel's VitSampleSmem
13	                 overflows the 227 KB dynamic-smem cap at d=1024, so gate it OFF —
14	                 the TC engine the bench drives uses a small static VitTcSmem). Mirrors
15	                 the decoder bench's -DSG_DEC_BENCH_LAYOUT=1 / -DSG_DEC_SCALAR_MEGAKERNEL=0.
16	  * --d 128   -> production branch (default; SG_VIT_BENCH_LAYOUT unset).
17	
18	USAGE
19	  # Size-ladder d=1024 build, 3 reps (report ms + steps/s):
20	  python tuning/vit_bench.py --d 1024 --B 16384 --reps 3
21	  # Production d=128 B=16384 median wall:
22	  python tuning/vit_bench.py --d 128 --B 16384 --reps 5
23	  # Old serial GEMM (interleave width 1) for the before/after A/B:
24	  python tuning/vit_bench.py --d 128 --B 16384 --reps 5 -D SG_TUNED_VIT_GEMM_INTERLEAVE=1
25	
26	Notes:
27	  * ViT width is COMPILE-fixed (the layout is a compile-time constant); --d selects
28	    the branch. Inputs are RANDOM (throughput, not a parity gate — correctness is the
29	    test suite's job). params/state are sized from the TU's exposed mod.TOTAL.
30	  * Times the production tc_train_step at ncta_cap=0 (one CTA/SM, full saturation).
31	"""
32	from __future__ import annotations
33	
34	import argparse
35	import os
36	import statistics
37	import sys
38	import time

41	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
42	sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

44	import torch  # noqa: E402

47	SM_GHZ = 1.98  # H100 SM boost clock (nvidia-smi clocks.max.sm = 1980 MHz); mirrors decoder_bench

51	def build_variant(d: int = 128, name: str | None = None, verbose: bool = False,
52	                  defines: list[str] | None = None, profile: bool = False):
53	    """JIT-build the ViT TC cell TU as a coexisting variant extension. Mirrors
54	    tuning/decoder_bench.build_variant.
55	
56	    `profile=True` adds -DSG_VIT_PROFILE=1 (the in-kernel clock64 per-phase timers,
57	    g_vit_prof_max [6 slots]; default OFF, NEVER on the production path) and selects a
58	    distinct module name (suffix `_prof`) so the profiled and un-profiled variants
59	    coexist in the torch-extensions build dir. The host pybind reader
60	    (tc_profile_read) is ALSO gated on SG_VIT_PROFILE, so the flag is mirrored into
61	    extra_cflags as well."""
62	    bench = (d != 128)
63	    flags = ["-O3", "-std=c++17", "--expt-relaxed-constexpr",
64	             "-gencode=arch=compute_90a,code=sm_90a",
65	             "-gencode=arch=compute_90a,code=compute_90a"]
66	    if bench:
67	        # d-scaled size-ladder layout branch + gate OFF the scalar megakernel
68	        # (its VitSampleSmem overflows the 227 KB dynamic-smem cap at large d; the TC
69	        # path the bench drives uses the small static VitTcSmem). Mirrors the decoder.
70	        flags.append("-DSG_VIT_BENCH_LAYOUT=1")
71	        flags.append("-DSG_VIT_SCALAR_MEGAKERNEL=0")
72	    if profile:
73	        flags.append("-DSG_VIT_PROFILE=1")
74	    suffix = ""
75	    if defines:
76	        for d_ in defines:
77	            flags.append("-D" + d_ if not d_.startswith("-D") else d_)
78	        norm = "_".join(d_.lstrip("-D").replace("=", "").replace(" ", "")
79	                        for d_ in defines)
80	        suffix = "_" + norm
81	    if name is None:
82	        name = "mega_vit_real_adamw_tc"
83	        name += "_bench" if bench else "_prod"
84	        if profile:
85	            name += "_prof"
86	        name += suffix
87	    os.environ.setdefault("TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST", "9.0a")
88	    # The host side (the pybind module: tc_profile_read[_head]) is also gated on

90	    host_defs = ["-DSG_VIT_PROFILE=1"] if profile else []
91	    mod = load(name=name, sources=[_TC_TU],
92	               extra_include_paths=[str(ROOT)],

95	               verbose=verbose)

99	# Slot order of g_vit_prof_max in fused_vit_megakernel.cuh (the device-side header
100	# comment is the ground truth; see lines ~490-497 + the atomicMax stamping sites at
101	# 611/612/618/646/660/1126). Mirrors decoder_bench.PHASE_NAMES. Slots:
102	#   [0] P1_fwd      — token-tile forward loop (vittc_forward_tile, prof_fwd accum)
103	#   [1] P1_bwd      — token-tile backward loop (vittc_backward_tile, prof_bwd accum)
104	#   [2] B1_barrier  — the bar.sync() after P1 (all acts + LN-vec partials complete)
105	#   [3] P2_dW_GEMM  — the dW output-stationary / split-K GEMM loop (vittc_dw_run_tile)
106	#   [4] P2_grad_asm — grad assembly: dW biases + cls/pos owner-scan + LN-vec reduce + loss
107	#   [5] P3_opt_tail — the real apply_optimizer<Opt> tail over the reduced grad
108	VIT_PHASE_NAMES = ["P1_fwd", "P1_bwd", "B1_barrier", "P2_dW_GEMM",
109	                   "P2_grad_asm", "P3_opt_tail"]

112	def measure(mod, d: int, B: int, reps: int, warmup: int, iters: int,
113	            profile: bool = False, ncta_cap: int = 0):
114	    # NUM_PATCHES/PATCH_DIM/VOCAB are d-INVARIANT (image patch geometry + head width),
115	    # so the oracle constants are correct at every ladder width; the layout's D scales.
116	    from tests.hw.vit_oracle import NUM_PATCHES, PATCH_DIM, VOCAB
117	    assert int(mod.D) == d, f"TU compiled at D={int(mod.D)}, expected {d}"
118	    dev = torch.device("cuda")
119	    total = int(mod.TOTAL)
120	    g = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(42)
121	    params = (torch.randn(total, generator=g, device=dev) * 0.02).contiguous()
122	    patches = torch.randn(B, NUM_PATCHES, PATCH_DIM, generator=g, device=dev).to(torch.float32).contiguous()
123	    targets = torch.randint(0, VOCAB, (B,), generator=g, device=dev).to(torch.int32).contiguous()
124	    state = torch.zeros(3 * total, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
125	    lr, beta1, beta2, eps, wd = 1e-3, 0.9, 0.98, 1e-8, 0.0
126	    bc1, bc2 = 1.0 - beta1, 1.0 - beta2
127	
128	    def call():
129	        return mod.tc_train_step(params, patches, targets, state, lr, beta1, beta2,
130	                                 eps, wd, bc1, bc2, 1, ncta_cap)
131	
132	    for _ in range(warmup):
133	        call()
134	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
135	
136	    walls = []
137	    for _ in range(reps):
138	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
139	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
140	        for _ in range(iters):
141	            call()
142	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
143	        walls.append((time.perf_counter() - t0) / iters)
144	    wall = statistics.median(walls)
145	    # Analytic dense-GEMM FLOPs for one fwd+bwd ViT step (the matmul work the roofline
146	    # counts; LN/softmax/elementwise ≈ 0). T = B*seq rows. Per layer: in_proj(d->3d),
147	    # out_proj(d->d), ff0(d->4d), ff2(4d->d). Plus the CLS head (d->vocab, M=B).
148	    # Backward ≈ 2x forward (dX + dW), so fwd+bwd ≈ 3x forward.
149	    layers, seq, dff = int(mod.LAYERS), int(mod.SEQ), 4 * d
150	    T = B * seq
151	    fwd = 0.0
152	    for _ in range(layers):
153	        fwd += 2.0 * T * (3 * d) * d      # in_proj
154	        fwd += 2.0 * T * d * d            # out_proj
155	        fwd += 2.0 * T * dff * d          # ff0
156	        fwd += 2.0 * T * d * dff          # ff2
157	    fwd += 2.0 * B * VOCAB * d            # CLS head (M=B)
158	    flops = 3.0 * fwd
159	    res = {"d": d, "B": B, "total_params": total, "wall_s": wall, "wall_ms": wall * 1e3,
160	           "steps_per_s": 1.0 / wall, "walls_ms": [w * 1e3 for w in walls],
161	           "gemm_flops_per_step": flops, "achieved_tf_s": flops / wall / 1e12}
162	
163	    if profile and getattr(mod, "HAS_PROFILE", False):
164	        # reset, run a few steps, read the max-across-CTAs per phase (every step has
165	        # ~identical work, so the accumulated max == one step's per-phase critical path).
166	        # 6 slots, mapped by VIT_PHASE_NAMES. Mirrors decoder_bench.measure.
167	        mod.tc_profile_read()  # reset
168	        prof_reps = []
169	        for _ in range(reps):
170	            mod.tc_profile_read()  # reset before this rep
171	            for _ in range(iters):
172	                call()
173	            torch.cuda.synchronize()
174	            prof_reps.append(mod.tc_profile_read())
175	        # median per slot across reps
176	        res["phase_cycles"] = [int(statistics.median(s)) for s in zip(*prof_reps)]
177	    return res

9	  * --d 1024  -> -DSG_MB_BENCH_LAYOUT=1 (the d=1024 branch of mamba3_layout.cuh, the
10	                 size-ladder roofline width: d_inner=2048, dt_rank=64) +
11	                 -DSG_MB_SCALAR_MEGAKERNEL=0 (the scalar megakernel's MambaSampleSmem
12	                 overflows the ~228 KB/SM budget at d=1024, so gate it OFF — the TC
13	                 engine the bench drives uses a small static MbTcSmem). Mirrors the
14	                 decoder bench's -DSG_DEC_BENCH_LAYOUT=1 / -DSG_DEC_SCALAR_MEGAKERNEL=0.
15	  * --d 128   -> production branch (default; SG_MB_BENCH_LAYOUT unset).
16	
17	USAGE
18	  # Size-ladder d=1024 build, 3 reps (report ms + steps/s):
19	  python tuning/mamba_bench.py --d 1024 --B 16384 --reps 3
20	  # Production d=128 B=16384 median wall:
21	  python tuning/mamba_bench.py --d 128 --B 16384 --reps 5
22	  python tuning/mamba_bench.py --d 128 --B 16384 --reps 5 -D SG_TUNED_MB_GEMM_INTERLEAVE=1
23	
24	Notes:
25	  * Mamba dims are COMPILE-fixed (the layout is a compile-time constant); --d selects
26	    the branch. Inputs RANDOM. params/state are sized from the TU's exposed mod.TOTAL.
27	  * Times the production tc_train_step at ncta_cap=0 (one CTA/SM, full saturation).
28	"""
29	from __future__ import annotations
30	
31	import argparse
32	import os
33	import statistics
34	import sys
35	import time
36	from pathlib import Path
37	
38	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
39	sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
40	
41	import torch  # noqa: E402
42	from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load  # noqa: E402
43	
44	_TC_TU = str(ROOT / "csrc/fused/sm_90/mega_mamba_real_adamw_tc.cu")
45	
46	
47	def build_variant(d: int = 128, name: str | None = None, verbose: bool = False,
48	                  defines: list[str] | None = None):
49	    bench = (d != 128)
50	    flags = ["-O3", "-std=c++17", "--expt-relaxed-constexpr",
51	             "-gencode=arch=compute_90a,code=sm_90a",
52	             "-gencode=arch=compute_90a,code=compute_90a"]
53	    if bench:
54	        # d-scaled size-ladder layout branch + gate OFF the scalar megakernel (its
55	        # MambaSampleSmem overflows the ~228 KB/SM budget at large d; the TC path the
56	        # bench drives uses the small static MbTcSmem). Mirrors the decoder bench.
57	        flags.append("-DSG_MB_BENCH_LAYOUT=1")
58	        flags.append("-DSG_MB_SCALAR_MEGAKERNEL=0")
59	    suffix = ""
60	    if defines:
61	        for d_ in defines:
62	            flags.append("-D" + d_ if not d_.startswith("-D") else d_)
63	        norm = "_".join(d_.lstrip("-D").replace("=", "").replace(" ", "")
64	                        for d_ in defines)
65	        suffix = "_" + norm
66	    if name is None:
67	        name = "mega_mamba_real_adamw_tc"
68	        name += "_bench" if bench else "_prod"
69	        name += suffix
70	    os.environ.setdefault("TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST", "9.0a")
71	    mod = load(name=name, sources=[_TC_TU],
72	               extra_include_paths=[str(ROOT)],
73	               extra_cuda_cflags=flags,
74	               extra_cflags=["-O3", "-std=c++17"],
75	               verbose=verbose)
76	    return mod
77	
78	
79	def measure(mod, d: int, B: int, reps: int, warmup: int, iters: int):
80	    # VOCAB/P_HEAD/SEQ are d-INVARIANT (token range, head width, seq len), so the
81	    # oracle constants are correct at every ladder width; the layout's D/DINNER scale.
82	    from tests.hw.mamba_oracle import VOCAB, P_HEAD, SEQ
83	    assert int(mod.D) == d, f"TU compiled at D={int(mod.D)}, expected {d}"
84	    dev = torch.device("cuda")
85	    total = int(mod.TOTAL)
86	    g = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(42)
87	    params = (torch.randn(total, generator=g, device=dev) * 0.02).contiguous()
88	    tokens = torch.randint(0, VOCAB, (B, SEQ), generator=g, device=dev).to(torch.int32).contiguous()
89	    targets = torch.randint(0, P_HEAD, (B,), generator=g, device=dev).to(torch.int32).contiguous()
90	    state = torch.zeros(3 * total, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
91	    lr, beta1, beta2, eps, wd = 1e-3, 0.9, 0.98, 1e-8, 0.0
92	    bc1, bc2 = 1.0 - beta1, 1.0 - beta2
93	
94	    def call():
95	        return mod.tc_train_step(params, tokens, targets, state, lr, beta1, beta2,
96	                                 eps, wd, bc1, bc2, 1, 0)
97	
98	    for _ in range(warmup):
99	        call()
100	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
101	
102	    walls = []
103	    for _ in range(reps):
104	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
105	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
106	        for _ in range(iters):
107	            call()
108	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
109	        walls.append((time.perf_counter() - t0) / iters)
110	    wall = statistics.median(walls)
111	    # Analytic dense-GEMM FLOPs for one fwd+bwd Mamba step (the matmul work the
112	    # roofline counts; the SSM scan + conv + elementwise ≈ 0). T = B*seq rows. Per
113	    # layer the projections are in_proj(d->2*d_inner), x_proj(d_inner->dbc),
114	    # dt_proj(dt_rank->d_inner), out_proj(d_inner->d). Plus the head (d->phead, M=B).
115	    # Backward ≈ 2x forward (dX+dW), so fwd+bwd ≈ 3x forward.
116	    layers, seq = int(mod.LAYERS), int(mod.SEQ)
117	    di, dtr, st = int(mod.DINNER), int(mod.DTRANK), int(mod.STATE)
118	    dbc = dtr + 2 * st
119	    T = B * seq
120	    fwd = 0.0
121	    for _ in range(layers):
122	        fwd += 2.0 * T * (2 * di) * d     # in_proj
123	        fwd += 2.0 * T * dbc * di         # x_proj
124	        fwd += 2.0 * T * di * dtr         # dt_proj
125	        fwd += 2.0 * T * d * di           # out_proj
126	    fwd += 2.0 * B * P_HEAD * d           # head (M=B)
127	    flops = 3.0 * fwd
128	    return {"d": d, "B": B, "total_params": total, "wall_ms": wall * 1e3,
129	            "steps_per_s": 1.0 / wall, "walls_ms": [w * 1e3 for w in walls],
130	            "gemm_flops_per_step": flops, "achieved_tf_s": flops / wall / 1e12}
131	
132	
133	def main():
134	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
135	    ap.add_argument("--d", type=int, default=128, help="Mamba d_model (128 prod | 1024 bench)")
136	    ap.add_argument("--B", type=int, default=16384)
137	    ap.add_argument("--reps", type=int, default=5)
138	    ap.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=8)
139	    ap.add_argument("--iters", type=int, default=20)
140	    ap.add_argument("--verbose-build", action="store_true")
141	    ap.add_argument("-D", dest="defines", action="append", default=[], metavar="KEY=VAL")
142	    args = ap.parse_args()
143	    assert args.B % 16 == 0, "B must be divisible by 16 (dW K-loop is 16-step atoms)"
144	    print(f"[mamba-bench] building variant: d={args.d} "
145	          f"(SG_MB_BENCH_LAYOUT={'1' if args.d != 128 else 'unset'})"
146	          + (f"  defines={args.defines}" if args.defines else ""), flush=True)
147	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
148	    mod = build_variant(args.d, verbose=args.verbose_build, defines=args.defines)
149	    print(f"[mamba-bench] build {time.perf_counter()-t0:.1f}s  D={int(mod.D)} DINNER={int(mod.DINNER)} "
150	          f"DTRANK={int(mod.DTRANK)} TILE_M={int(mod.TILE_M)} TOTAL={int(mod.TOTAL):,} "
151	          f"TILE_N={int(mod.TILE_N)}", flush=True)
152	    res = measure(mod, args.d, args.B, args.reps, args.warmup, args.iters)
153	    print(f"\n[mamba-bench] d={res['d']}  B={res['B']}  params={res['total_params']:,}", flush=True)
154	    print(f"  wall/step = {res['wall_ms']:.4f} ms  "
155	          f"(median of {[f'{x:.3f}' for x in res['walls_ms']]})", flush=True)
156	    print(f"  steps/s   = {res['steps_per_s']:.4f}", flush=True)
157	    print(f"  GEMM FLOPs/step = {res['gemm_flops_per_step']:.3e}  "
158	          f"=> achieved {res['achieved_tf_s']:.3f} TF/s "
159	          f"({100.0 * res['achieved_tf_s'] / 989.0:.2f}% of 989 TF/s bf16 dense roofline)",
160	          flush=True)
161	    return res
162	
163	
164	if __name__ == "__main__":
165	    main()

1	"""Matmul-precision analysis — FULL grid (owner spec).
2	
3	7 precision arms × 33 cells (3 models × ALL 11 optimizers) × 3 seeds = 693 runs.
4	Arms: fp32 (reference), tf32, bf16, fp16amp (fp16 autocast + GradScaler), and
5	the H100-native sub-16-bit modes implemented in grokking_optimizers/lowprec.py:
6	fp8 (E4M3 fwd / E5M2 grads), fp8e5m2 (E5M2 acts × E4M3 weights), int8
7	(IMMA forward / bf16 backward). In EVERY mode weights, optimizer state, grads
8	at the optimizer boundary, meta/SAM side-steps and evaluate() are fp32.
9	
10	Engineering for a multi-hour sweep:
11	  • RESUMABLE: every finished run is appended (flock'd) to
12	    results/h100_grokking_race/precision_analysis_full.jsonl; on restart the
13	    grid is diffed against recorded (precision, model, optimizer, seed) keys.
14	  • SHARDED WORKERS (no locking): worker i runs grid entries where
15	    index % nworkers == i. Launch N workers with --launch N (MPS-aware).
16	  • DEAD-STOP: a run that hasn't memorized (train_acc < 0.30) by half-cap is
17	    aborted and recorded as an early DNF (same heuristic as the tuner).
18	  • Verdicts count TEST-CONFIRMED groks only (val-grok with test < 0.90 is a
19	    fake-grok, recorded as such); partial-crash cells are counted explicitly
20	    (audit A6 fix — a 1-of-3-crash cell must not masquerade as low-accuracy).
21	
22	Usage:
23	  python -m tuning.precision_analysis --launch 4      # spawn 4 shard workers
24	  python -m tuning.precision_analysis --worker 0 --nworkers 4   # (internal)
25	  python -m tuning.precision_analysis --report        # md + png + verdicts
26	"""
27	from __future__ import annotations
28	
29	import argparse
30	import fcntl
31	import json
32	import subprocess
33	import sys
34	import time
35	from pathlib import Path
36	
37	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
38	OUT = ROOT / "results" / "h100_grokking_race"
39	JSONL = OUT / "precision_analysis_full.jsonl"
40	
41	PRECISIONS = ("fp32", "tf32", "bf16", "fp16amp", "fp8", "fp8e5m2", "int8")
42	MODELS = (("decoder", 5000), ("vit", 6000), ("mamba", 12000))
43	OPTS = ("adamw", "neuralgrok", "grokadamw", "supergrok", "supergrok15",
44	        "supergrok2", "grokfast", "muon", "lion", "looksam", "prodigy")
45	SEEDS = (42, 123, 456)
46	TRAIN_FN = {"adamw": "train_adamw", "neuralgrok": "train_neuralgrok",
47	            "grokadamw": "train_grokadamw", "supergrok": "train_supergrok",
48	            "supergrok15": "train_supergrok15", "supergrok2": "train_supergrok2",
49	            "grokfast": "train_grokfast", "muon": "train_muon",
50	            "lion": "train_lion", "looksam": "train_looksam",
51	            "prodigy": "train_prodigy"}
52	
53	_G = None
54	
55	def _g():
56	    global _G
57	    if _G is None:
58	        sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
59	        import grokking_race_v2 as g
60	        _G = g
61	    return _G
62	
63	
64	def grid():
65	    out = []
66	    for precision in PRECISIONS:
67	        for model, cap in MODELS:
68	            for opt in OPTS:
69	                for seed in SEEDS:
70	                    out.append((precision, model, cap, opt, seed))
71	    return out
72	
73	
74	def recorded_keys():
75	    keys = set()
76	    if JSONL.exists():
77	        for line in JSONL.read_text().splitlines():
78	            try:
79	                r = json.loads(line)
80	                keys.add((r["precision"], r["model"], r["optimizer"], r["seed"]))
81	            except Exception:
82	                continue  # tolerate a truncated trailing record
83	    return keys
84	
85	
86	def append_row(row: dict):
87	    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
88	    with open(JSONL, "a") as fh:
89	        fcntl.flock(fh, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
90	        fh.write(json.dumps(row) + "\n")
91	        fh.flush()
92	        fcntl.flock(fh, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
93	
94	
95	class _DeadStop(Exception):
96	    pass
97	
98	
99	_DATA = {}
100	
101	def _data_init(model, seed):
102	    import torch
103	    key = (model, seed)
104	    if key not in _DATA:
105	        g = _g()
106	        c = dict(g.DEFAULT_CONFIG)
107	        c.update({"model_type": model, "p": 97, "frac_train": 0.5,
108	                  "val_ratio": 0.10, "seed": seed})
109	        dev = torch.device("cuda")
110	        data = tuple(d.to(dev) for d in g.make_data_for_task(c, seed))
111	        m0 = g.build_model(c, dev)
112	        init = {k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in m0.state_dict().items()}
113	        del m0
114	        _DATA[key] = (data, init)
115	    return _DATA[key]
116	
117	
118	def run_one(precision, model, cap, opt, seed):
119	    import torch
120	    g = _g()
121	    c = dict(g.DEFAULT_CONFIG)
122	    c.update(g.OPTIMIZER_CONFIGS[opt])
123	    c.update({"seed": seed, "model_type": model, "frac_train": 0.5,
124	              "val_ratio": 0.10, "p": 97, "compile_model": False,
125	              "use_fused": True, "weight_decay": 1.0,
126	              "max_steps": cap, "early_stop_max_steps": cap,
127	              # 10-step record grid; patience is in EVALS → hold window =
128	              # 50 evals × 10 steps = 500 steps post-grok (collapse check)
129	              "eval_every": 10, "early_stop_on": "val",
130	              "early_stop_threshold": 0.95, "early_stop_patience": 50})
131	    if precision == "fp16amp":
132	        c["use_amp"] = True  # fp16 autocast + GradScaler (matmul_precision inert here)
133	    else:
134	        c.update({"use_amp": False, "matmul_precision": precision})
135	    dead_by = cap // 2
136	
137	    def cb(step, train_acc, val_acc, test_acc):
138	        if step >= dead_by and train_acc < 0.30:
139	            raise _DeadStop()
140	    c["_eval_callback"] = cb
141	
142	    data, init = _data_init(model, seed)
143	    dev = torch.device("cuda")
144	    fn = getattr(g, TRAIN_FN[opt])
145	    torch.manual_seed(seed)
146	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
147	    dead = False
148	    try:
149	        r = fn(c, init, *data, dev, bp=0)
150	    except _DeadStop:
151	        dead = True
152	        r = None
153	    wall = time.perf_counter() - t0
154	    row = {"precision": precision, "model": model, "optimizer": opt,
155	           "seed": seed, "cap": cap, "wall_s": wall}
156	    if dead or r is None:
157	        row.update({"dead_stopped": True, "grok_step_val": None,
158	                    "test_confirmed": False, "final_test_acc": 0.0,
159	                    "peak_val_acc": 0.0})
160	        return row
161	    te = r.test_accs or [0.0]
162	    va = r.val_accs or [0.0]
163	    row.update({
164	        "dead_stopped": False,
165	        "grok_step_val": r.grokking_step,
166	        "test_confirmed": (r.grokking_step is not None
167	                           and r.final_test_acc >= 0.90),
168	        "final_test_acc": float(r.final_test_acc),
169	        "peak_test_acc": float(max(te)), "peak_val_acc": float(max(va)),
170	        "total_steps": int(r.total_steps),
171	        "component_failures": dict(getattr(r, "component_failures", {}) or {}),
172	    })
173	    return row
174	
175	
176	def mode_worker(args):
177	    g_ = grid()
178	    done = recorded_keys()
179	    mine = [e for i, e in enumerate(g_) if i % args.nworkers == args.worker]
180	    todo = [e for e in mine if (e[0], e[1], e[3], e[4]) not in done]
181	    print(f"[w{args.worker}] {len(todo)}/{len(mine)} runs pending", flush=True)
182	    for precision, model, cap, opt, seed in todo:
183	        try:
184	            row = run_one(precision, model, cap, opt, seed)
185	        except Exception as e:
186	            import traceback; traceback.print_exc()
187	            row = {"precision": precision, "model": model, "optimizer": opt,
188	                   "seed": seed, "cap": cap, "crashed": repr(e)[:300]}
189	        append_row(row)
190	        gs = row.get("grok_step_val")
191	        print(f"[w{args.worker}] {precision:8s} {opt:11s}/{model:7s} s{seed} "
192	              f"grok={gs} test={row.get('final_test_acc', 0):.3f} "
193	              f"{'DEAD' if row.get('dead_stopped') else ''}"
194	              f"{'CRASH' if 'crashed' in row else ''}", flush=True)
195	    print(f"[w{args.worker}] shard complete", flush=True)
196	
197	
198	def mode_launch(args):
199	    procs = []
200	    for i in range(args.launch):
201	        p = subprocess.Popen(
202	            [sys.executable, "-m", "tuning.precision_analysis",
203	             "--worker", str(i), "--nworkers", str(args.launch)],
204	            cwd=ROOT)
205	        procs.append(p)
206	        time.sleep(3)
207	    print(f"launched {len(procs)} analysis shard workers", flush=True)
208	    for p in procs:
209	        p.wait()
210	    print("all shards complete", flush=True)
211	    mode_report(args)
212	
213	
214	def mode_report(args):
215	    import statistics as st
216	    rows = []
217	    for line in JSONL.read_text().splitlines():
218	        try:
219	            rows.append(json.loads(line))
220	        except Exception:
221	            continue
222	    lines = ["# Matmul-precision analysis — FULL grid (7 arms × 33 cells × 3 seeds)",
223	             "", "Weights/opt-state/grads-at-boundary/meta/SAM/eval are fp32 in",
224	             "ALL modes. Verdicts count TEST-CONFIRMED groks only.", ""]
225	    summary = {}
226	    for precision in PRECISIONS:
227	        ok_cells = total_cells = 0
228	        lines.append(f"## {precision}")
229	        lines.append("| cell | confirmed grok | median grok step | final test (mean, non-crashed) | dead | crashed |")
230	        lines.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
231	        for model, cap in MODELS:
232	            for opt in OPTS:
233	                sub = [r for r in rows if r.get("precision") == precision
234	                       and r.get("model") == model and r.get("optimizer") == opt]
235	                if not sub:
236	                    continue
237	                total_cells += 1
238	                crash = [r for r in sub if "crashed" in r]
239	                live = [r for r in sub if "crashed" not in r]
240	                ok = [r for r in live if r.get("test_confirmed")]
241	                steps = [r["grok_step_val"] for r in ok if r.get("grok_step_val")]
242	                fts = [r.get("final_test_acc", 0.0) for r in live]
243	                deads = sum(1 for r in live if r.get("dead_stopped"))
244	                lines.append(
245	                    f"| {opt}/{model} | {len(ok)}/{len(sub)} | "
246	                    f"{int(st.median(steps)) if steps else '—'} | "
247	                    f"{st.mean(fts):.3f}" + (f" ({len(live)}/{len(sub)})" if crash else "")
248	                    + f" | {deads} | {len(crash)} |")
249	                if len(ok) == len(sub) and sub:
250	                    ok_cells += 1
251	        summary[precision] = (ok_cells, total_cells)
252	        lines.append("")
253	    lines.append("## Verdicts")
254	    for p, (okc, tot) in summary.items():
255	        lines.append(f"- **{p}**: {okc}/{tot} cells at full confirmed-grok rate")
256	    (OUT / "PRECISION_ANALYSIS_FULL.md").write_text("\n".join(lines))
257	    print(f"wrote {OUT/'PRECISION_ANALYSIS_FULL.md'} ({len(rows)} rows)", flush=True)
258	    try:
259	        import matplotlib
260	        matplotlib.use("Agg")
261	        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
262	        import numpy as np
263	        # heatmap: cells × precisions, value = confirmed-grok count (0-3)
264	        cells = [f"{o}/{m}" for m, _ in MODELS for o in OPTS]
265	        mat = np.full((len(cells), len(PRECISIONS)), np.nan)
266	        for pi, precision in enumerate(PRECISIONS):
267	            ci = 0
268	            for model, _ in MODELS:
269	                for opt in OPTS:
270	                    sub = [r for r in rows if r.get("precision") == precision
271	                           and r.get("model") == model and r.get("optimizer") == opt]
272	                    if sub:
273	                        mat[ci, pi] = sum(1 for r in sub if r.get("test_confirmed"))
274	                    ci += 1
275	        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 14))
276	        im = ax.imshow(mat, cmap="RdYlGn", vmin=0, vmax=3, aspect="auto")
277	        ax.set_xticks(range(len(PRECISIONS))); ax.set_xticklabels(PRECISIONS, rotation=45)
278	        ax.set_yticks(range(len(cells))); ax.set_yticklabels(cells, fontsize=7)
279	        for i in range(len(cells)):
280	            for j in range(len(PRECISIONS)):
281	                if not np.isnan(mat[i, j]):
282	                    ax.text(j, i, int(mat[i, j]), ha="center", va="center", fontsize=7)
283	        ax.set_title("Test-confirmed groks per cell (of 3 seeds) × precision")
284	        fig.colorbar(im, shrink=0.5); fig.tight_layout()
285	        fig.savefig(OUT / "precision_analysis_full.png", dpi=140)
286	        print(f"wrote {OUT/'precision_analysis_full.png'}", flush=True)
287	    except Exception as e:
288	        print(f"figure skipped: {e}", flush=True)
289	
290	
291	def main():
292	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
293	    ap.add_argument("--launch", type=int, default=0)

3	Owner-specified design (2026-06-09):
4	  • Runs BEFORE the race; zero impact on race FLOPs/wall (race later just loads
5	    results/tuning/tuned_configs.json).
6	  • Bayesian (TPE) + early-stopping pruner, REAL-size p=97 task (no tiny
7	    proxies — grokking phase transitions don't transfer across scale); the
8	    cheap axis is the step budget, not model/data size.
9	  • SINGLE standardized objective for every (optimizer, model) study:
10	    **fewest gradient steps to val_acc ≥ 0.95, TEST-CONFIRMED** (wall-clock
11	    explicitly does not matter — this tunes the high-level algorithm). A val-grok
12	    counts only if it transferred to the held-out TEST split (≥ 0.90); val-trained
13	    meta-nets can otherwise fake-grok val.
14	      grokked:    value = grokking_step  (∈ [1, CAP])
15	      fake-grok:  value = CAP + (1 − final_test_acc)·CAP   (val-grok, test < 0.90)
16	      DNF:        value = CAP + (1 − max(peak_val, 0.5·peak_train))·CAP
17	                  (gives TPE a gradient through the memorize-but-no-grok region)
18	      crashed:    config-fault only → value = 2·CAP + (1 − last peak_val)·100

282	def make_objective(opt: str, model: str):
283	    import optuna
284	
285	    cap = CAPS[model]
286	    # [pruner intent] dead_by = cap*0.5 (no memorization by the half-budget ⇒
287	    # hopeless): decoder 2500, vit 3000, mamba 6000 (the prior fixed mamba 6000
288	    # already equalled cap*0.5; decoder/vit move onto the same rule). Distinct
289	    # from the MedianPruner's first prunable rung at step 500 (n_warmup_steps
290	    # 490 + the every-10-step cb.report cadence) — dead_by is the never-memorized
291	    # hard kill, the pruner handles slow-but-progressing trials.
292	    dead_by = cap // 2
293	
294	    def objective(trial: "optuna.Trial") -> float:
295	        params = {}
296	        for key, kind, lo, hi in SPACES[opt]:
297	            if kind == "log":
298	                params[key] = trial.suggest_float(key, lo, hi, log=True)
299	            elif kind == "lin":
300	                params[key] = trial.suggest_float(key, lo, hi)
301	            else:
302	                params[key] = trial.suggest_int(key, int(lo), int(hi))
303	        # Owner decision (2026-06-10): precision dimension REMOVED — industry
304	        # standard fixed bf16 everywhere (race DEFAULT_CONFIG); trials inherit it.
305	
306	        # [A6] last-known peak val, updated live in cb, so a CONFIG crash mid-run
307	        # still gets a gradient-carrying score (vs a flat worst constant).
308	        peak_val_cell = [0.0]
309	
310	        def cb(step, train_acc, val_acc, test_acc):
311	            # Composite progress signal: pre-grok, val sits ≈0 even for GOOD
312	            # configs while train memorizes first — pruning on val alone would
313	            # kill them. memorize→0.5, grok→≈1.45.
314	            #
315	            # Cadence note: metrics are EVALUATED every gradient step (owner
316	            # directive — grokking_step resolution comes from the val-stopper
317	            # at full fidelity), but trial.report hits the lock-guarded SHARED
318	            # journal — with 14 MPS workers, per-step appends serialized the
319	            # fleet on the file lock (GPU fell to ~23% util). Report every
320	            # 10th step instead; the pruner compares rungs at matched steps,
321	            # so pruning decisions lose nothing.
322	            if val_acc > peak_val_cell[0]:
323	                peak_val_cell[0] = val_acc
324	            if step % 10 == 0:
325	                trial.report(val_acc + 0.5 * train_acc, step)
326	                if trial.should_prune():
327	                    raise optuna.TrialPruned()
328	            if step >= dead_by and train_acc < 0.30:
329	                raise optuna.TrialPruned()  # never even memorized
330	
331	        try:
332	            out = run_trial_config(opt, model, params, TUNING_SEED, eval_cb=cb)
333	        except optuna.TrialPruned:
334	            raise
335	        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
336	            # [A6-HIGH] Crash classification: INFRA failures (CUDA OOM, generic
337	            # CUDA errors, stale-ABI / pybind-boundary TypeErrors) are NOT the
338	            # config's fault — poisoning the trial with a crash score would make
339	            # TPE flee a perfectly good region. Prune them (no score). Only
340	            # GENUINE config failures (everything else — bad shapes, NaNs that
341	            # raise, component asserts) get the crash score, and that score
342	            # carries a gradient via the last-known peak val so TPE still learns
343	            # the bad region's shape rather than seeing a flat wall.
344	            msg = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
345	            low = msg.lower()
346	            is_infra = (
347	                "out of memory" in low or "cuda error" in low or "cuda runtime" in low
348	                or "abi" in low or "cublas" in low or "cudnn" in low or "nccl" in low
349	                # Optuna JournalStorage lock blips (e.g. "Error: did not possess
350	                # lock" when a sibling held the symlink lock across an MPS stall)
351	                # are storage infrastructure, not the config — observed scored as
352	                # a 10100 config-DNF in the v5 era (adamw__decoder #18).
353	                or "possess lock" in low or "lock file" in low
354	                or "mps server" in low  # MPS daemon teardown/restart window
355	                or isinstance(exc, TypeError)  # pybind-boundary signature mismatch
356	            )
357	            if is_infra:
358	                trial.set_user_attr("infra_crash", msg[:300])
359	                raise optuna.TrialPruned()
360	            trial.set_user_attr("crash", msg[:300])
361	            return 2.0 * cap + (1.0 - peak_val_cell[0]) * 100.0
362	        trial.set_user_attr("peak_val_acc", out["peak_val_acc"])
363	        trial.set_user_attr("peak_train_acc", out["peak_train_acc"])
364	        trial.set_user_attr("final_test_acc", out["final_test_acc"])
365	        if out["grokking_step"] is not None:
366	            # Fake-grok guard: the SuperGrok meta-nets TRAIN on the val split,
367	            # so "val ≥ 0.95" alone is a circular success criterion for them —
368	            # a config could overfit val while test stays low. Credit the
369	            # val-grok only if it transferred to the held-out TEST split;
370	            # otherwise score it as a DNF. (Audit finding; applies uniformly to
371	            # all optimizers so the metric stays standardized.)
372	            if out["final_test_acc"] >= 0.90:
373	                return float(out["grokking_step"])
374	            trial.set_user_attr("fake_grok", True)
375	            return cap + (1.0 - out["final_test_acc"]) * cap
376	        # [A6-HIGH] DNF (no val-grok): shape the score with the better of peak
377	        # val and HALF peak train. Pre-grok, val sits ≈0 while train memorizes,
378	        # so peak-val alone is a flat wall across the whole memorize-but-no-grok
379	        # region; 0.5*peak_train gives TPE a gradient toward configs that at
380	        # least learned the train set (the necessary precursor to grokking).
381	        return cap + (1.0 - max(out["peak_val_acc"],
382	                                0.5 * out.get("peak_train_acc", 0.0))) * cap
383	
384	    return objective

407	            # [A6] n_startup_trials 8→12 (match sampler). [pruner intent]
408	            # n_warmup_steps 999→490: the first prunable rung is the report at
409	            # step 500 (cb reports every 10th step), so 490 lets step-500 rungs
410	            # prune (was 999 = effectively no pruning until step 1000).
411	            n_startup_trials=12, n_warmup_steps=490, interval_steps=1),
412	        load_if_exists=True,
413	    )
